notes: Update item discounts: the legacy form is a copy of the item card whose class-discount lines (AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC) and customer lines (ST_CUST_ITEMS, see ST_CUST_ITEMS) are edited per item; the generated grid on ST_ITEM_CLASSES (item class codes) was wrong. Corrected to the class-discount lines per item (search by item), same line rules as AR_ST_ITEM_CLASSES, new lines from the load-all-classes button (APP_RULES3_SA). Wave 3b: CLASS_CODE shows the discount classes (the automatic list was AS_CLASS, asset classes), units of the item, item name.

row_rules.AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC:
-- legacy line WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM / PRE-INSERT: class, active group of the item, unit of the item (basic by default),
-- retail price and MOH discount by default, price 0..99999.99, non-negative discounts / bonus, no repeated item per class
app_rules3_sa.disc_line_row('AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC', inserting, :new.class_code, null, :new.item_group_code, :new.item_code, :new.unit_code,
  :new.sales_price, :new.disc_ratio1, :new.disc_ratio2, :new.disc_ratio3, :new.bonus_ratio, :new.extra_bonus_ratio);

AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC.CLASS_CODE.lov: select class_code || ' - ' || nvl(desc_a, desc_e) d, class_code r from ar_st_item_classes order by class_code

AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC.UNIT_CODE.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a || decode(iu.basic_unit, 1, ' (وحدة أساسية)', '') d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and (iu.group_code = :PAGE_ITEM_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_ITEM_GROUP_CODE is null) and iu.unit_code = u.unit_code order by 2

AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code and i.item_group_code = t.item_group_code)

params.name: ITEM
params.lov_sql: select item_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(name_e, name_a), name_a) d, item_code r from st_item where nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 or item_group_code in (select group_code from st_group_password where password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by item_code

params.name: LOAD_MODE
params.lov_sql: select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Add without deleting', 'أضافة بدون حذف') d, 1 r from dual union all select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Delete all and add', 'حذف الكل والأضافة'), 2 from dual
